# 3 bed terraced house for sale

> Ann O'Neill Auctioneers are delighted to present No. 13 Lakeview Drive to the market. Ideally positioned within the popular and well-maintained Lakeside development, No. 13 Lakeview Drive is an attractive three-bedroom mid-terraced home, originally constructed circa 2005. This warm and comfortable timber-frame property offers well-proportioned accommodation extending to approximately 85.
